title: Enforce OAuth scopes on administrative webhook routes
reason: by design: legacy admin webhook API gated by requireAdmin; Jira defines no OAuth scope for it

title: Restrict openSprints() to active sprints
reason: by design: Jira Cloud openSprints() returns all non-closed (active and future) sprints

title: Webhook delivery runs one at a time inside the request with a 10s timeout
reason: by design: @emulators/core WebhookDispatcher also delivers sequentially and awaited with a 10s timeout
